verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator distributed via npm and open-sourced on GitHub (yylo-gh-3), implying it runs locally/self-hosted rather than as a SaaS, and the CLI/init/task flow can be run entirely on a user's own machine. However there is no explicit documentation describing self-hosting a 'core product' server, deployment instructions, Docker/self-host guides, or licensing terms confirming full self-hostability of any backend/service component. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting/deployment docs, confirmation of no mandatory hosted backend, license clarity for self-hosting, and independent corroboration of running fully offline/self-hosted.
